schedule.pruning: no large-Gaussian pruning (global size pruning is not used)
schedule.densification: grow/prune opacity < 0.005 at i = 600, 700, ..., 2400 in every arm
schedule.means_lr: exponential decay to 0.01 x initial over 3000 steps, then constant
schedule.sh_degree: 0 / 1 / 2 from i = 0 / 1000 / 2000, capped at 2 in every arm
schedule.after_2500: no densification or pruning; optimization only
schedule.densification_criterion: AbsGS: absolute 2-D gradients (rasterization absgrad=True) with grow_grad2d 0.0008, the threshold gsplat documents for absgrad
